description: Implement the Repository layer on the backend chosen by the Phase 0 storage spike (preferred: Turso WASM on OPFS, running in a dedicated storage worker; fallback: IndexedDB). Domain code must not depend on the backend. Repositories for recordings, audio_chunks, transcript_tokens, speaker_turns, speaker_attributions, people, voice_profiles, voice_samples, summaries, provider_runs, settings. Versioned migrations. Transcript rows reference clusterId, never names. plan.md §8.
title: Storage: typed repositories and SQL migrations on Turso/OPFS (IndexedDB fallback)
